name: mask-validate
summary: checks one mask sequence, a mask-1 manifest and the frame files it lists, and reports the first fault it finds

arguments.name: SEQUENCE
arguments.meaning: a folder that holds manifest.txt, or the path of a manifest file; the frame files are read from the folder of the manifest

arguments.name: extra
arguments.meaning: not allowed: two or more arguments are a usage error, exit 2

streams.stdout: the success line on exit 0; empty on exit 1 for an invalid sequence and on exit 2; on exit 1 for an unwritable standard output, the success line may be partly written
streams.stderr: empty on exit 0; exactly one line on exit 1 for an invalid sequence and on exit 2; on exit 1 for an unwritable standard output, unspecified and not pinned by a test

frame_form: PGM, binary form P5, header exactly P5 LF width SP height LF maxval LF, maxval 255 for depth 8 or 65535 for depth 16, 16 bit samples most significant byte first
hash: SHA-256 of the whole frame file, as 64 lower-case hexadecimal digits
success_line: ok format=mask-1 frames=N first=F width=W height=H depth=D
error_line: error: WORD: DETAIL, where DETAIL is manifest.txt for manifest_missing, line 1 for manifest_format, line N for manifest_syntax and manifest_value, the frame file name for frame_missing, frame_header, frame_size, frame_depth, frame_truncated, frame_trailing, frame_hash and frame_extra, and the frame file name or . for the folder for frame_read
check_order: the manifest line by line; then each frame in index order: present, header, size, depth, length, hash; then frame-named files the manifest does not list
determinism: the same files give the same exit code and the same bytes on both streams, except the text after read failed: and the unpinned paths; on a file system that ignores case, a frame file name that differs only in case is found under the listed name

reasons.means: the folder named holds no file manifest.txt
a manifest line breaks the form
the first line names a form other than mask-1
a value in its grammar but out of its range
a listed frame file is absent or not a regular file
a frame file does not begin with the canonical header
the width or height of a frame differs from the manifest
the maxval of a frame differs from the depth of the manifest
a frame file is shorter than its header and samples
a frame file has bytes after its samples
the SHA-256 of a frame file differs from the manifest
the folder holds a frame-named file that the manifest does not list
a present frame file, or the folder listing, cannot be read

unpinned_paths.stderr: error: frame_read: FILE, or error: frame_read: .

unpinned_paths.stdout: the success line may be partly written

exit_codes.stdout: ok format=mask-1 frames=3 first=0 width=4 height=2 depth=8
ok format=mask-1 frames=3 first=0 width=4 height=2 depth=8
